title: Twist Bioscience reports fiscal third-quarter 2026 financial results
publisher: Twist Bioscience Corporation via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Fiscal Q3 revenue rose 23% to USD 118.4 million, gross margin was 52.8%, and fiscal 2026 revenue guidance increased to USD 456-457 million.
summary: The SEC-filed fiscal Q3 release remains current operating evidence for growth, gross margin, profitability, customer shipments, and guidance.
